name: TransactionClosingChecklist
tagline: Run every deal closing from one closing room – CPs, signature pages in escrow, funds flow and post-closing.
description: A complete Power Platform app for corporate, finance and real-estate legal teams: conditions precedent, signature pages held in escrow, closing deliverables, dependencies, funds flow and post-closing obligations, with a closing room per deal, five go/no-go gates and one-click Release & close.
features: Eight statuses with business rules and allowed transitions
Signature matrix with chase lists per party
Five closing gates and Release & close
CP waivers with waiving party and reference
Bulk actions, undo and CSV export
Demo mode with six fictional deals
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.TransactionClosingChecklist data-set; niray_Niray.TransactionClosingChecklistPortal field control)
